# R5.56 — Admit the scoped `bridge`-network cell profile as a first-class `PodmanBackend` variant

Implements `docs/tickets/247_R5.56__egress-variant.md` (seq 247 of 251 —
S4-completion extension, manifest `## Plan extensions` 2026-11-06, under
the operator's verbatim authorizations recorded there). The S4 egress
supplement ran its `declared_deps` cells on the scratch
`/tmp/s4-helper-egress` binary (`hh_helper.rs` verbatim + one knob)
because the stock helper hardcoded `network: false`. This ticket
sanctions that profile as first-class machinery — required for R5.58's
GCE re-execution of the 50 inconclusive frozen-cohort slots — while
keeping `none` the default posture for untrusted participants. Offline,
USD $0.00, no external egress authorized by this row.

- **`hh-helper --network <none|bridge>`** (default `none`) +
  `S4_HELPER_NETWORK` env fallback — the flag wins; unknown flag *or*
  env value is usage(2), never coerced. `PodmanBackend::create_args()`
  extracted so the `--network bridge|none` spelling is observable
  without a live podman.
- **Policy-driven cell network** — `EnvDriver::start_helper` routes the
  podman argv through `egress_profile::podman_helper_args`: an attached
  `net.mode = public` policy appends `--network bridge`; `none`/
  `mediated` produce argv byte-identical to the pre-variant triple
  (`mediated` is its own declared posture, never silently widened).
- **`egress_profile::admit_declared_deps`** — the transactional
  admission: requires declared deps + owned/closed `host_bridge`
  residual + `local_container` class (else typed
  `Unsupported{egress_profile.declared_deps}`); mutates a policy
  candidate to `net.mode = public` +
  `residual_channels[host_bridge{statement, owner, closer}]`, runs
  `validate()` (`PublicWithoutResidual`/`PublicBelowPrincipal` still
  fire — consulted, never bypassed), then stamps `record.ext` with the
  supplement's `hh-s4-egress-supplement/1` field spellings verbatim:
  `egress_profile: declared_deps`, `cell_network: bridge`,
  `policy_net_mode: public`, `declared_deps[]`. A bridge cell is
  structurally never labelled `none`.
- **ADR-0421** — the admission record: provenance (scratch variant
  superseded), `declared_deps`-only scope, the N4 residual declaration,
  `none` the preserved default, the honesty bound (bridge declares
  `public` — never `none`/`mediated`).

Requirement ids stamped: **contributing-only `R-2.8.4`** (the
containment/egress policy enforcement surface). No primary ownership —
the S4 cohort predicates (`REQ-D-101/102/103`, `REQ-E-011`) stay owed
to R5.58/R5.59; this ticket lands machinery, not a cohort.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-helper/src/bin/hh_helper.rs` — the `--network` flag +
  `S4_HELPER_NETWORK` env fallback, closed `none|bridge` sum, usage(2)
  on unknown; `network: network_on` at the `PodmanBackend` literal.
- `crates/hh-helper/src/podman.rs` — `create_args()` extracted (create
  calls it unchanged); unit leg `create_args_map_network_verbatim`.
- `crates/hh-env/src/egress_profile.rs` (new) — `podman_helper_args` +
  `admit_declared_deps` + the record-spelling constants.
- `crates/hh-env/src/driver.rs` — `start_helper` routes the podman
  argv through `podman_helper_args(h.containment.policy())`.
- `crates/hh-env/src/lib.rs` — `pub mod egress_profile;`.
- `crates/hh-helper/tests/r5_56.rs` (new) — 7 legs against the real
  binary + a `podman` stub on `PATH` (every verb logs argv, exits 0):
  bridge/none/absent argv, env-selects-bridge, flag-wins-over-env,
  usage(2) on unknown flag + env.
- `crates/hh-env/tests/r5_56.rs` (new) — 7 legs: argv derivation per
  mode, honest-policy admission + verbatim ext stamps, undeclared/
  unowned/non-container typed refusals, `PublicWithoutResidual` +
  `PublicBelowPrincipal` still firing, absent-admission stamps nothing.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0421-r5.56-egress-variant.md` (new) +
  `docs/build/BACKLOG.csv` (BL-47 sources += ADR-0421) + regenerated
  `docs/adr/README.md` + `docs/adr/REVISIT_TRIGGERS.md`.
- `docs/build/runs/R5.56.md`, `docs/build/pr/R5.56.md`, BUILD_INDEX
  seq-247 row, LEDGER state + phase log.

No new dependency, no schema/codegen change, no event class or
`RecordKind`, no second policy codec (CC1 — `hh-containment`'s own
`NetMode`/`ResidualChannel`/`validate()` reused).
